name: alpacawork
description: Run all your AI agents from one chat. Open-source task management for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents: an AI assigns your requests to agents on your own PC and tracks their progress. Works from your phone too.
author: Masahiro Tonomura

scripts.build: node scripts/testing/queue.ts build -- node scripts/testing/run.ts build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/testing/queue.ts typecheck -- sh -c 'pnpm build:packages && pnpm build:apps && pnpm typecheck:built'
scripts.i18n:check: pnpm i18n:extract && git diff --exit-code -- packages/i18n/src/locales && node packages/i18n/check-filled.ts
scripts.test:e2e:run: node scripts/testing/queue.ts e2e -- playwright test -c e2e --workers=8
scripts.test:e2e:fixtures: node scripts/testing/queue.ts e2e -- node --test --test-concurrency=2 e2e/fixture-regression.test.ts e2e/fixture-boundaries.test.ts e2e/motion-settled.test.ts e2e/guard.test.ts e2e/read-persistence.test.ts e2e/serve-lifetime.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:offline: node scripts/testing/queue.ts e2e -- playwright test -c e2e/offline-scope.config.ts --workers=4
scripts.test:web: node scripts/testing/queue.ts web -- vitest run --config apps/web/vitest.config.ts --maxWorkers=8
scripts.test:real-agents: pnpm build && node scripts/testing/queue.ts node -- node tests/acceptance/real-agents.mjs
scripts.build:diagnostic: node scripts/testing/queue.ts build -- node scripts/testing/run.ts build --kind diagnostic
